title: McTrivia
description: Asks you Minecraft trivia questions for a reward.
body:
## Installation
Go though this process **every time you download or update**
1. Download
2. Go though normal installation process. (If you don't know what to do here search up "minecraft datapack how to install" on YouTube or something like that)
3. run command /function trivia:settings/load_default (this loads the default settings and is required in order to run)
4. run command /funtion trivia:loop/trivia to start asking you questions every 3min or run /funtion trivia:no_loop/trivia_no_loop to just ask a single question.
## Config
Run /function trivia:settings/config to open config.
### Time:
Sets how long you get to answer the question.
### Guesses:
Sets how many guesses you get.
### Death penalty mode:
Sets whether you die if you get a question wrong.
### Race mode:
Sets if you must be the first person to answer the question to get a reward.
## Advanced
All settings are just fake players on a "trivia" scoreboard so if you want a setting to be higher or lower than the config lets you than you can, but note that this **is NOT intended and will MOST LIKELY cause bugs that WILL NOT be fixed.**
### Report any bugs on the Discord: [https://discord.gg/cwTNRAyban](https://discord.gg/cwTNRAyban)
